35100.commentary: (DNt) dhāraṇabalan'ti dhāraṇasaṅkhātaṃ balaṃ, dhāraṇe vā balaṃ, ubhay'atthā'pi dhāretuṃ sāmatthiyanti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: evaṃ dhammasenāpatinā ca pasatthabhāv'ānurūpaṃ attano dhāraṇabalaṃ dassento sattānaṃ sotu'kamyataṃ janeti evaṃ me sutaṃ, tañ'ca kho atthato vā byañjanato vā anūnaman'adhikaṃ, evam'eva na aññathā daṭṭhabban'ti.

35102.meaning2: ready to be worn; fit to wear

examples.text: evaṃ, bhante'ti kho so puriso pukkusassa mallaputtassa paṭissutvā taṃ siṅgīvaṇṇaṃ yugamaṭṭhaṃ dhāraṇīyaṃ āhari.

kāsikasukhumāni dhāraya, abhiropehi ca mālavaṇṇakaṃ, kañcanamaṇimuttakaṃ bahuṃ, vividhaṃ ābharaṇaṃ karomi te.

dujjānaṃ kho etaṃ, mahārāja, tayā gihinā kāmabhoginā puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvasantena kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhontena mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhārayantena jātarūparajataṃ sādiyantena, ime vā arahanto, ime vā arahattamaggaṃ samāpannā'ti.
anekasākhañ'ca sahassamaṇḍalaṃ, chattaṃ marū dhārayum'antalikkhe, suvaṇṇadaṇḍā vītipatanti cāmarā, na dissare cāmarachattagāhakā.

dve bhāgā suddhakāḷakānaṃ eḷakalomānaṃ ādātabbā'ti dhārayitvā dve tulā ādātabbā.

yo hoti bhikkhu arahaṃ katāvī, khīṇ'āsavo antimadehadhārī, ahaṃ vadāmī'ti'pi so vadeyya, mamaṃ vadantī'ti'pi so vadeyyā'ti.
na te idaṃ citta yathā purāṇakaṃ, n'āhaṃ alaṃ tuyha vase nivattituṃ, mah'esino pabbajito'mhi sāsane, na mādisā honti vināsadhārino.

35122.meaning1: should be carried; should be held; should be worn

examples.text: evaṃ te abhikkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ te paṭikkamitabbaṃ, evaṃ te āloketabbaṃ, evaṃ te viloketabbaṃ, evaṃ te samiñjitabbaṃ, evaṃ te pasāritabbaṃ, evaṃ te saṅghāṭipattacīvaraṃ dhāretabban'ti.

35123.meaning1: should be kept; should be stored

35124.meaning1: should be remembered; should be considered

35125.meaning1: rememberer; retainer; who keeps in mind

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sotā ca hoti, sāvetā ca, uggahetā ca, dhāretā ca, viññātā ca, viññāpetā ca, kusalo ca sahitāsahitassa, no ca kalahakārako, imehi kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭhahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu dūteyyaṃ gantum'arahati.
seyyathā'pi, bho gotama, nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya, cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantī'ti.
sa ve indriyasampanno, santo santipade rato, dhāreti antimaṃ dehaṃ, jetvā māraṃ savāhinin'ti.

35128.meaning1: bears in mind; keeps in mind; remembers (something about)
35128.commentary: (SNa) upāsakaṃ maṃ, bhante, bhagavā dhāretū'ti maṃ bhagavā, upāsako ayan'ti evaṃ dhāretu, jānātū'ti attho.

35134.meaning2: having borne, having held, having worn

35139.meaning1: (of a horse) galloping; dashing; (comm) fleeing or pursuing
35139.commentary: (MNa) jave'ti sīghavāhane. dhāve'ti'pi pāṭho. attano parājaye sati palāyan'atthaṃ, paraṃ palāyantaṃ anubandhitvā gahaṇ'atthañ'ca etaṃ kāraṇaṃ kāreti.

examples.text: yato kho, bhaddāli, bhadro ass'ājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti, tam'enaṃ assadamako uttari kāraṇaṃ kāreti anukkame maṇḍale khurakāse dhāve davatte rājaguṇe rājavaṃse uttame jave uttame haye uttame sākhalye.

yena sallena otiṇṇo, disā sabbā vidhāvati, tam'eva sallam'abbuyha, na dhāvati na sīdati.
sarasaṅkappānan'ti dhāvanasaṅkappānaṃ.

35148.meaning1: shame on you!; what!; damn you!

examples.text: dhitipparaṃ kiṃ mama citta kāhisi, na te alaṃ citta vas'ānuvattako, na jātu bhastaṃ ubhatomukhaṃ chupe, dhi'r'atthu pūraṃ nava sotasandaniṃ.

mah'odadhiṃ aparimitaṃ mahāsaraṃ, bahubheravaṃ ratanagaṇānam'ālayaṃ, najjo yathā naragaṇasaṅghasevitā, puthū savantī upayanti sāgaraṃ.
dhitipparaṃ kiṃ mama citta kāhisi, na te alaṃ citta vas'ānuvattako, na jātu bhastaṃ ubhatomukhaṃ chupe, dhi'r'atthu pūraṃ nava sotasandaniṃ.

35152.commentary: (MNa) evaṃ gahitaṃ dhāritaṃ sajjhāyaṃ kātuṃ samatthavīriyaṃ dhiti nāma.

examples.text: idha me assu, sāriputta, cattāro sāvakā vassasat'āyukā vassasatajīvino, paramāya satiyā ca gatiyā ca dhitiyā ca samannāgatā paramena ca paññāveyyattiyena.

35153.meaning1: practising determination; (comm) resolved on the ultimate goal
35153.commentary: (THa) dhitipparan'ti dhitiparāyaṇaṃ paramaṃ thirabhāve ṭhitaṃ mamaṃ, citta, kiṃ kāhisi, tato īsakam'pi maṃ cāletuṃ n'āsakkhissasī'ti attho.

examples.text: dhitipparaṃ kiṃ mama citta kāhisi, na te alaṃ citta vas'ānuvattako, na jātu bhastaṃ ubhatomukhaṃ chupe, dhi'r'atthu pūraṃ nava sotasandaniṃ.
upāyāsā ca te sabbe, viddhastā vinaḷīkatā, sītibhūto damappatto, dhitimā saccanikkamo.
adhisīlaṃ adhicittaṃ, adhipaññañ'ca vīriyavā, thāmavā dhitimā jhāyī, sato gutt'indriyo care.

35155.commentary: (ANa) tass'eva c'āyasmato buddhavacanaṃ uggaṇhanavīriyaṃ sajjhāyanavīriyañ'ca dhāraṇavīriyañ'ca satthu upaṭṭhānavīriyañ'ca aññehi asadisaṃ ahosi, tasmā dhitimantānaṃ aggo nāma jāto. (THa) satimanto'ti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato. dhitimanto'ti asādhāraṇāya byañjan'atth'āvadhāraṇa-samatthāya dhitisampattiyā samannāgato. ayañ'hi thero ekapade'y'eva ṭhatvā saṭṭhipadasahassāni satthārā kathitaniyāmen'eva gaṇhāti, gahitañ'ca suvaṇṇabhājane pakkhittasīhavasā viya sabbakālaṃ na vinassati, aviparīta-byañjan'āvadhāraṇa-samatthāya satipubbaṅ'gamāya paññāya, atth'āvadhāraṇa-samatthāya paññāpubbaṅ'gamāya satiyā ca samannāgato. ten'āha bhagavā, etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ bahussutānan'tiādi (a. ni. 1.219). tathā c'āha dhammasenāpati, āyasmā ānando atthakusalo'tiādi (a. ni. 5.169). (MNt) dhitimantānan'ti dhāraṇabalena yuttānaṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, sāriputta, daḷhadhammā dhanuggaho sikkhito katahattho kat'ūpāsano lahukena asanena appakasiren'eva tiriyaṃ tālacchāyaṃ atipāteyya, evaṃ adhimattasatimanto evaṃ adhimattagatimanto evaṃ adhimattadhitimanto evaṃ paramena paññāveyyattiyena samannāgatā.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhitimantānaṃ yadidaṃ ānando.

35156.commentary: (NIDD1a) dhīrā'ti dhīrā iti. puna dhīrā'ti paṇḍitā. dhitimā'ti dhiti assa atthī'ti dhitimā. dhitisampannā'ti paṇḍiccena samannāgatā.

examples.text: yo dhīro dhitisampanno, jhāyī jhānarato sadā, ahorattaṃ anuyuñjaṃ, jīvitaṃ anikāmayaṃ.

35157.meaning1: shame on you!; damn you!; curse you!; to hell with!

examples.text: dhitipparaṃ kiṃ mama citta kāhisi, na te alaṃ citta vas'ānuvattako, na jātu bhastaṃ ubhatomukhaṃ chupe, dhi'r'atthu pūraṃ nava sotasandaniṃ.
tatra sudaṃ, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro antepuraṃ gato dukkhī dummano pajjhāyati, dhi'r'atthu kira, bho, jāti nāma, yatra hi nāma jātassa jarā paññāyissatī'ti!

35158.meaning1: shame on you!; woe on him!; damn you!

examples.text: na brāhmaṇassa pahareyya, n'āssa muñcetha brāhmaṇo, dhī brāhmaṇassa hantāraṃ, tato dhī yassa muñcati.
dhī taṃ jammi jare atthu, dubbaṇṇakaraṇī jare, tāva manoramaṃ bimbaṃ, jarāya abhimadditaṃ.
yattakaṃ tulitā esā, tuyhaṃ dhītā anopamā, tato aṭṭhaguṇaṃ dassaṃ, hiraññaṃ ratanāni ca.
atha kho kokanadā pajjunnassa dhītā abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇā kevalakappaṃ mahāvanaṃ obhāsetvā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.

examples.text: pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ. na so, bhikkhave, satto sulabharūpo yo na dhītābhūtapubbo iminā dīghena addhunā. taṃ kissa hetu?
tapanīyakatā'va dhītikā, vicarasi cittalat'eva accharā, kāsikasukhumehi vaggubhi, sobhasī suvasanehi n'ūpame.

35163.meaning2: attitude as to the daughter; a state of mind like to the daughter

examples.text: etha tumhe, bhikkhave, mātumattīsu mātucittaṃ upaṭṭhapetha, bhaginimattīsu bhaginicittaṃ upaṭṭhapetha, dhītumattīsu dhītucittaṃ upaṭṭhapethā'ti.

35165.meaning1: paternal affection; love for one's daughter

examples.text: etha tumhe, bhikkhave, mātumattīsu mātucittaṃ upaṭṭhapetha, bhaginimattīsu bhaginicittaṃ upaṭṭhapetha, dhītumattīsu dhītucittaṃ upaṭṭhapethā'ti.

35167.meaning2: death of a daughter or of daughters

examples.text: dīgharattaṃ vo, bhikkhave, pitumaraṇaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ… bhātumaraṇaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ… bhaginimaraṇaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ… puttamaraṇaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ… dhītumaraṇaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ… ñātibyasanaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ… bhogabyasanaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ.
yamhi paccaye pare dā dhā mā ṭhā hā pā maha matha icc'evam'ādīnaṃ dhātūnaṃ anto īkāram'āpajjate. dīyati, dhīyati, mīyati, ṭhīyati, hīyati, pīyati, mahīyati, mathīyati.

35174.synonym: avaṭṭhita, thira, thera, nikkama, nicca, nibaddha

ye ca kho te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū nikkuhā nillapā dhīrā atthaddhā susamāhitā, te kho me, bhikkhave, bhikkhū māmakā. anapagatā ca te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmā dhammavinayā. te ca imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ viruḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjantī'ti.

35175.synonym: ñāṇī, nipaka, pañña, paññava, paññavant, paññāṇavant, paññāvant, paṇḍita, matimant, matīmant, mutimant, mutīmant, viññujātika, viññū, vibhāvī, sapañña, sappañña

examples.text: diṭṭhe dhamme ca yo attho, yo c'attho samparāyiko, atth'ābhisamayā dhīro, paṇḍito'ti pavuccatī'ti.
pañcannaṃ dhīro bhayānaṃ na bhāye, bhikkhu sato sapariyantacārī, ḍaṃs'ādhipātānaṃ sarīsapānaṃ, manussaphassānaṃ catuppadānaṃ.
pamādaṃ appamādena, yadā nudati paṇḍito, paññāpāsādam'āruyha, asoko sokiniṃ pajaṃ, pabbataṭṭho'va bhūmaṭṭhe, dhīro bāle avekkhati.
ubhosu antesu vineyya chandaṃ, phassaṃ pariññāya anānugiddho, yadattagarahī tadakubbamāno, na lippatī diṭṭhasutesu dhīro.

35177.meaning1: way of the wise; quality of a sage
35177.commentary: (PVa) sa dhīradhammo'ti yā yathāvuttā dānādānappavatti, so dhīrānaṃ dhitisampannānaṃ nītinayakusalānaṃ dhammo, tehi gatamaggo'ti dīpeti. (JAa) sa dhīradhammo'ti piṇḍiy'ālopena yāpetabbaṃ, esa paṇḍitānaṃ dhammo'ti.

examples.text: yo ca sīlena sampanno, sutavā paṭibhānavā, saññato dhīradhammesu, paññāy'atthaṃ vipassati.
adānam'atidānañ'ca, nappasaṃsanti paṇḍitā, tasmā hi dānā dhanam'eva seyyo, samena vatteyya sa dhīradhammo'ti.

35178.meaning1: esteemed by the wise; (or) considered to be intelligent; deemed wise

examples.text: ye ca sante upāsanti, sappaññe dhīrasammate, saddhā ca nesaṃ sugate, mūlajātā patiṭṭhitā.
āraññiko hohi ca piṇḍapātiko, sosāniko hohi ca paṃsukūliko, nesajjiko hohi sadā dhute rato, itissu maṃ citta pure niyuñjasi.

aṭṭha dhut'aṅgāni, āraññik'aṅgaṃ, piṇḍapātik'aṅgaṃ, paṃsukūlik'aṅgaṃ, tecīvarik'aṅgaṃ, sapadānacārik'aṅgaṃ, khalupacchābhattik'aṅgaṃ, nesajjik'aṅgaṃ, yathāsanthatik'aṅgaṃ, idaṃ vuccati vataṃ, na sīlaṃ.

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gahapati, idh'assa nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto cātuyāmasaṃvarasaṃvuto sabbavārivārito sabbavāriyutto sabbavāridhuto sabbavāriphuṭo. so abhikkamanto paṭikkamanto bahū khuddake pāṇe saṅghātaṃ āpādeti.

35184.commentary: (VINa) yā paṭipadā kilese dhunāti, tāya samannāgatattā dhutā.

examples.text: mahākassapo'pi ca thero, uttattakanakasannibho, dhutaguṇe agganikkhitto, thomito satthuvaṇṇito.

35186.commentary: (NIDD1a) tasmiṃ yathāsanthate viharituṃ sīlam'assā'ti yathāsanthatiko, tassa aṅgaṃ yathāsanthatik'aṅgaṃ. sabbān'eva pan'etāni tena tena samādānena dhutakilesattā dhutassa bhikkhuno aṅgāni, kilesadhunanato vā dhutan'ti laddhavohāraṃ ñāṇaṃ aṅgaṃ etesan'ti dhut'aṅgāni. atha vā dhutāni ca tāni paṭipakkhānaṃ dhunanato aṅgāni ca paṭipattiyā'ti'pi dhut'aṅgāni.

examples.text: aṭṭha dhut'aṅgāni, āraññik'aṅgaṃ, piṇḍapātik'aṅgaṃ, paṃsukūlik'aṅgaṃ, tecīvarik'aṅgaṃ, sapadānacārik'aṅgaṃ, khalupacchābhattik'aṅgaṃ, nesajjik'aṅgaṃ, yathāsanthatik'aṅgaṃ, idaṃ vuccati vataṃ, na sīlaṃ.

35187.meaning2: who has shaken off, destroyed the defilements

35189.meaningLit: bearing the factors of shaking off
35189.commentary: (ANt) dhut'aṅgadharo hotī'ti vuttam'ev'atthaṃ pakāseti terasa dhut'aṅgaguṇe samādāya vattatī'ti.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ dhut'aṅgadharānaṃ yadidaṃ mahākassapo.

35190.meaning1: explanation of the ascetic practices; chapter in the Visuddhimagga

35192.meaning2: speaking of, preaching dhutaṅgas; instructing in ascetic practices

35194.meaningLit: for the sake of shaking off

examples.text: apaññattena vuccamāno, idaṃ na sallekhāya na dhut'atthāya na pāsādikatāya na apacayāya na vīriy'ārambhāya saṃvattatī'ti anādariyaṃ karoti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

35195.commentary: (ANa) dhutadhammā veditabbā'ti app'icchatā santuṭṭhitā sallekhatā pavivekatā idamaṭṭhikatā'ti ime dhut'aṅgacetanāya parivārā pañca dhammā appicchaṃ'y'eva nissāyā'ti-ādi-vacanato (a. ni. 5.181, pari. 325) dhutadhammā nāma. tattha app'icchatā ca santuṭṭhitā ca alobho, sallekhatā ca pavivekatā ca dvīsu dhammesu anupatanti alobhe c'eva amohe ca, idamaṭṭhitā ñāṇam'eva. tattha alobhena paṭikkhepavatthūsu lobhaṃ, amohena tesv'eva ādīnavappaṭicchādakaṃ mohaṃ dhunāti. alobhena ca anuññātānaṃ paṭisevanamukhena pavattaṃ kāmasukhallik'ānuyogaṃ, amohena dhutaṅgesu atisallekhamukhena pavattaṃ attakilamath'ānuyogaṃ dhunāti. tasmā ime dhammā dhutadhammā'ti veditabbā.

examples.text: sāvako'pi khīṇ'āsavo sāvakabodhiyā hetubhūte puññasambhāre sambharanto pubbayogaṃ pubbacariyaṃ gatapaccāgatavattaṃ pūrento carimabhave nibbattanto anukkamena viññutaṃ patvā saṃsāre ādīnavaṃ disvā pabbajjāya cetayamāno pabbajjaṃ matthakaṃ pāpetvā sīl'ādīni paripūrento dhutadhamme samādāya…
catutthe dhutavādānan'ti ettha dhuto veditabbo, dhutavādo veditabbo, dhutadhammā veditabbā, dhut'aṅgāni veditabbāni. tattha dhuto'ti dhutakileso vā puggalo kilesadhunano vā dhammo.
passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, kassapaṃ sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ caṅkamantan'ti? evaṃ, bhante. sabbe kho ete, bhikkhave, bhikkhū dhutavādā.

tena kho pana samayena āyasmā piṇḍolabhāradvājo bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya āraññiko piṇḍapātiko paṃsukūliko tecīvariko app'iccho santuṭṭho pavivitto asaṃsaṭṭho āraddhavīriyo dhutavādo adhicittam'anuyutto.

35199.meaning2: who leads a corrupted life, scoundrel, cheat

examples.text: itthidhutto surādhutto, akkhadhutto ca yo naro, laddhaṃ laddhaṃ vināseti, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.
acchinnacīvaro nāma bhikkhussa cīvaraṃ acchinnaṃ hoti rājūhi vā corehi vā dhuttehi vā, yehi kehici vā acchinnaṃ hoti.
